HOME.HISTORY_TEXT: B&B Darrè is located behind Piazza Ruggero Settimo, where the very important and active Politeama-Garibaldi Theater is situated. This square is in the heart of the historic center of Palermo and close to the city/’s main monuments and tourist attractions. The name of the B&B comes from Palermitan dialect where â€œdarreâ€ means behind, as it is located precisely behind the famous Politeama Theater. The word â€œdarreâ€ can also be freely interpreted as â€œda reâ€ – meaning â€œroyallyâ€, in reference to our rooms which, while being of simple and essential furnishings, offer many comforts that make for a very pleasant stay. The symbol of the B&B is inspired by the most honorable emblem of the city, the Genius of Palermo, depicted as a crowned mature man with a divided beard, embraced by a snake which bites his chest. The Genius of Palermo is the personification of the city, a symbol of its inhabitants, its ethnic, cultural, religious, and social origins. It is believed to date back to the pre-Roman times. The B&B is located on Piazza Don Luigi Sturzo, where there are private and public transportation services available to take you along the main city arteries.

POLITEAMA.NAME: Politeama
POLITEAMA.DESCRIPTION: It is named after one of the most fascinating theaters in the city, the Politeama-Garibaldi, which is located just behind the B&B. The Theater’s design was entrusted to Giuseppe Damiani Almeyda through a construction competition in 1866. In 1874 it was initially inaugurated without roof, and only three years later in 1877 it was covered by the Orotea foundry, a metal structure which was considered innovative engineering at the time.
POLITEAMA.TYPE: The room is a triple with one double bed and one single bed

RULES.TITLE: Internal regulation
RULES.INTRO_LINE1: We are pleased to welcome you to the Darrè Bed and Breakfast.
RULES.INTRO_LINE2: We invite you to read our internal regulations.
RULES.GENERAL_INTRO: The conduct to be observed at the B&B is not only that required by law, but above all that dictated by common sense and mutual respect.
RULES.RULE_ID_DOC: Guests are requested, upon arrival, to show an identification document for completing the Public Safety card (data processed in accordance with the obligations of the law n. 675 of 31/12/96).
RULES.RULE_ARRIVAL_NOTICE: Since the bed & breakfast is a small family-run establishment, there is no reception service available at all times of the day as is the case for hotels, therefore each customer is required to communicate (message, e-mail or telephone) to owner of the structure, the expected arrival time, at least 24 hours before the arrival. Going to the hotel without having advised about the arrival time can cause long waits. This mistake cannot be a reason for complaints or claims for reimbursement.
RULES.RULE_NO_GUESTS: Guests are not allowed to access other people inside the B&B at any time, for reasons of Public Security.
RULES.RULE_CHECKIN_WINDOW: Except in cases previously agreed, the rooms are available from 12 to 20 (Check –in). On the day of departure (Check-out) the rooms must be vacated by 10:00 to allow the final cleaning of the room.
RULES.RULE_BREAKFAST_TIME: Breakfast is served between 8:00 AM and 9:30 AM (unless otherwise agreed).
RULES.RULE_NO_SMOKING: Smoking inside the premises is strictly forbidden.
RULES.RULE_PETS: The property welcomes pets, to be agreed in advance.
RULES.RULE_QUIET_HOURS: In compliance with the B&B regulation and the municipal police regulations, silence must be observed in the time slot between 14.00 and 16.00 and from 22.00 to 08.00.
